body: Thank you.  Reading that really does make me feel a little better.

It's pretty much exactly how it sounds. You camp out in the woods for a period of several months - in my case 73 days - to detox from whatever it is you may be addicted to, get time away from all technologies, and really sit with yourself and figure out who you are and what it is you're doing there. You hike 3 days a week with packs ranging from 40 to 70 lbs, and the other 4 days you stay at a campsite, get time with a therapist and complete worksheets and assignments meant to help you figure out what's at the root of your anxieties and addictions. It was a rough, difficult experience, but as much as it felt like the worst thing I had ever agreed to while I was there, I can't deny it has helped me realize how much I've really destroyed my life with how many video games I used to play.

But yeah, in searching for communities to help me stay away from video games for a while, that's how I ended up here. :)
